blocks.raw: ## Attributes - Tracker based
blocks.text: Attributes - Tracker based

blocks.raw:
Attribute Definition
trackerValueBeforeEvent Gets the tracker value of a customer excluding the current event — the total accumulated across all previous events. Can be used in any set of the workflows, and can be used in loyalty promotions also. Trackers that are created based on alternate currencies will only work with this profile, as those tracker won't be visible in tracker/points-tracker sets. **Note:** Use this function when checking cumulative thresholds in tier upgrade conditions (for example, verifying that a customer has completed a target number of rentals). Because it reflects the total before the current event is processed, the comparison is stable regardless of the order in which sets are evaluated. * \*E.g.:\*\*currentCustomer.trackerValueBeforeEvent("Tracker name", "Case name")>\<=X
trackerValueCurrentEvent Gets the tracker value of a customer including the changes that happened during the current event (until the previous set). Can be used in any set of the workflows (evaluation set, end set), and can be used in loyalty promotions also. Trackers that are created based on alternate currencies will only work with this profile, as those tracker won't be visible in tracker/points-tracker sets. **Note:** For cyclic or calendar-based trackers where each transaction contributes a fixed unit (for example, 1 rental = 1 unit), this function returns only that event's contribution, not the running total. A condition like `trackerValueCurrentEvent >= 6` will therefore always be false after any individual rental. To check whether a customer has reached a cumulative threshold across multiple events, use `trackerValueBeforeEvent` instead. * \*E.g.:\*\*currentCustomer.trackerValueCurrentEvent("Tracker name", "Case name")>\<=X

blocks.raw: ### Customer status behavior and possible values
blocks.text: Customer status behavior and possible values

blocks.raw: The `customerStatus` attribute reflects the current status of the customer profile. Common values include `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE`, and `NOT SET`.
blocks.text: The customerStatus attribute reflects the current status of the customer profile. Common values include ACTIVE, INACTIVE, and NOT SET.

blocks.raw:
* When a customer registers via MAPP\_SDK and no status is provided, the system sets the status to `NOT SET` by default.
* If the same customer later registers via INSTORE, the system treats this as a profile combine. The status remains `NOT SET` unless the INSTORE registration explicitly sets a status.
* If your organization has not enabled the default option to set new users as `ACTIVE`, only INSTORE registrations with an explicit status will set the status to `ACTIVE`.
* Customers with a `NOT SET` status may experience login issues, as some systems require an `ACTIVE` status for successful login.

The status remains NOT SET unless the INSTORE registration explicitly sets a status.If your organization has not enabled the default option to set new users as ACTIVE, only INSTORE registrations with an explicit status will set the status to ACTIVE.Customers with a NOT SET status may experience login issues, as some systems require an ACTIVE status for successful login.

blocks.raw: **Recommendation:**
blocks.text: Recommendation:

blocks.raw:
* Enable the default option to set new users as `ACTIVE` if you want all new registrations to have an active status.
* Ensure that INSTORE registrations explicitly set the status to avoid unintended `NOT SET` values.

blocks.raw: ## Attribute - Milestones & Streaks
blocks.text: Attribute - Milestones & Streaks

blocks.raw:
Attribute Definition Link
avgTargetAchieved(targetName) Returns the average of the target value achieved by the customer across the cycles of the milestone (target). [Link](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/attributes-milestones-streaks#avgtargetachievedtargetname)
targetAchievedInPeriod(targetName, periodRefCode) Returns the target value achieved by the customer in a specific cycle/period of a particular milestone. `periodRefCode` is the name of the cycle, not the cycle ID. [Link](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/attributes-milestones-streaks#targetachievedinperiodtargetname-periodrefcode)
isStreakAchieved(streakName) Returns a true/false value indicating whether a user has achieved a specific streak level. Assume there is a streak (ABC) with two levels in it (ABC\_1, ABC\_2). This will indicate whether the customer has achieved the specific level or not. [Link](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/attributes-milestones-streaks#isstreakachievedstreakname)
streakCurrentValue(streakName) Returns the current streak value of the customer (instead of a simple true/false) for a specific streak level. [Link](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/attributes-milestones-streaks#streakcurrentvaluestreakname)
targetsAchievedForUnified(unifiedTargetGroupName, periodRefCode) Returns the number of targets achieved by the user in a specific cycle/period of a specific unified target. Assume there is a unified target (ABC) that contains three targets (A, B, C) which the user has to achieve. This will return the number of targets achieved by the user in a cycle of ABC. [Link](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/attributes-milestones-streaks#targetsachievedforunifiedunifiedtargetgroupname-periodrefcode)
targetAchievedInCurrentPeriod(targetName) Returns the target value achieved by the customer during the current cycle.\ Only target name is required here and there's no need to specify the cycle's refCode. If there is no current cycle, the return value will be 0. [Link](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/attributes-milestones-streaks#targetachievedincurrentperiodtargetname)
targetsAchievedForUnifiedInCurrentPeriod(unifiedTargetGroupName) Returns the number of targets achieved by the user during the current cycle of a specific unified target.\ Only target name is required here and there's no need to specify the cycle's refCode If there is no current cycle, the return value will be 0. [Link](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/attributes-milestones-streaks#targetsachievedforunifiedincurrentperiodunifiedtargetgroupname)
